observations: Three photos show a white and black vertical console in a wooden shelf with warm lighting.
The console has a white front panel and a black central spine with visible ventilation grills.
A white and black DualSense-style controller is placed next to the console in all photos.
The console's design matches the PlayStation 5 'Fat' model (CECH-4000 series) with its distinctive white and black color scheme and vertical orientation.
No branding or model numbers are visible on the console or controller in any photo.
The console appears to have some minor surface marks or smudges, especially on the black spine in photo 2.
The controller has the standard DualSense layout with touchpad, analog sticks, and buttons, but no visible branding.

identity.kind: PS5 Fat console with one controller

claims.evidence: The console's physical design matches the PS5 Fat model, but no model number or storage capacity is visible in any photo. The 1TB claim cannot be verified remotely.
Jailbreaking status cannot be confirmed from photos alone. No screen or interface is shown to verify the firmware version or modifications.
A single controller is visible in all photos, matching the description of 'One Pad'.
No games or game cases are visible in the photos. The presence of these games cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Console may not be genuine PS5 or may be a counterfeit
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's model number label (usually on the back or bottom) and a photo of the system info screen showing the model and firmware version.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic console with unknown brand, significantly lower than genuine PS5.

risks.risk: Jailbroken status may be false or the console may be bricked
risks.proof: A video clip showing the console powering on, displaying the PS5 home screen, and demonstrating the jailbreak interface or modified firmware version.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-jailbroken or non-functional, with lower value.

risks.risk: Storage capacity may not be 1TB (could be 500GB or 825GB model)
risks.proof: A photo of the system settings screen showing the internal storage capacity, or a photo of the model number label which indicates the storage variant.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lowest storage variant (500GB) until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or damaged
risks.proof: A video clip showing the controller being paired with the console and demonstrating all buttons, analog sticks, and touchpad functionality.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working or damaged controller, reducing overall value.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console's model number label (back or bottom)
Video clip showing the console powering on and displaying the system info screen with model and storage capacity
Video clip showing the jailbreak interface or modified firmware version
Photo or video of the controller being paired and tested with the console
Photo of any included games or game cases
response.reason: The console's identity is consistent with a PS5 Fat model, but critical details like model number, storage capacity, and jailbreak status cannot be verified from the current photos. The risks of counterfeit, incorrect storage, or non-functional jailbreak are significant and must be resolved before pricing.
